evaluation_status: Prospective protocol. No native data census, baseline run, scorer validation, contamination qualification or successful reproduction claimed.
evaluation_modes: Interactive tool-using investigator with fixed compute/tool budget
Program authored before protected evaluation and then executed without adaptation
Optional matched information-budget direct-input arm only when whole scientifically sufficient cases can be represented; never counted as a new task
paper_code_conditions: Paper + permitted data versus paper + identical data + audited official source are access conditions of this family, not separate benchmark counts. Protected labels and executable-result caches are excluded in both.
qualification_rule: No promotion until complete input/cohort inventory, rights, deterministic reference, leakage probes, competent baselines, protected scoring and independent scientific review pass. A null or reversed biological conclusion is a valid scientific outcome.
title: Retrospective held-horizon prediction of goal-aligned movement from odor-memory dynamics

paper.title: Neural dynamics for working memory and evidence integration during olfactory navigation in Drosophila
paper.version_note: Earlier preprint PMC12632460 and a repository named 2025 are the same family, not extra candidates.

scientific_question: Within the released offline imaging/behavior derivatives, do fan-shaped-body neural histories add information about later goal-aligned movement beyond sensory and movement histories, and does this relationship differ between persistent VT062617 and transient 52G12 populations?

estimand.primary: Retrospective, animal-macro held-horizon reduction in squared error for mean goal-aligned speed over (odor offset, odor offset+5 s], using neural plus nuisance history versus the strongest preselected competent nuisance-only validation baseline. Goal-aligned speed is explicitly calc_speed(t)*cos(theta(t)-theta_goal), where theta_goal is the valid circular mean over the final 1 s before the physical-offset reference. This scalar-speed/body-heading measure is not asserted to be exact physical displacement velocity.
estimand.required_inference: Report genotype and pulse/plume condition separately, paired fly-level neural-minus-nuisance losses, and complete eligibility/coverage. Future odor re-encounters are evaluator-only descriptive strata and never remove primary cases or enter inputs. Linear odor-integration filters are supporting historical analyses, not additional task counts.
estimand.historical_replay: Recompute published persistence, behavior associations and filters only after resolving the full historical recipe, cohort/event lists, normalization, smoothing, thresholds, boundary handling and inference procedure. Preserve literal equation/code behavior; separately name stabilized variants. Historical future-bump selection and two-sided filters are never treated as direct held-horizon predictor features.
estimand.claim_limit: This is retrospective prediction conditional on released derivatives, whose all-trial baseline and other transforms can contain later observations. A past-window mask does not establish prospectively causal exposure. It supports neither online navigation forecasting nor causal effects of odor/neural activity. Optogenetic necessity and search-optimality simulations remain separate full-paper claims.

whole_input_inventory.required_cohort: All released imaging and synchronized behavior for both VT062617 and 52G12, all pulse, wind-shift, no-wind/no-odor controls and plume trials. Supplement reports VT062617 15 recorded/14 eligible bump-analysis flies, 52G12 11 pulse flies; plume endpoint has 8 VT062617 flies, with 6 eligible filters and 5 52G12 filters. These groups may overlap: do not sum into unique animal count without the map. Preserve all 15/11 and every plume animal; preregister transparent quality rules rather than deleting subjects to recover significance.

objects.contents_required: All per-fly syncstruct MATs and the complete allflies_filenames mapping: trial genotype/identity, odor/wind commands and timing, wind speed/direction, open/closed loop flags, FicTrac heading and velocity, plume indices and coordinates, dff_green/red/diff and imaging timestamps.
All odor-delivery calibration recordings; commanded offset must be related to measured physical odor dynamics.
Official full derived-data schema; retained as documentation only.

objects.reason: Anatomical validation, not a mandatory input to the conditional recorded-neural-dynamics endpoint. Needed to independently reproduce anatomy or source-population targeting.

whole_input_inventory.expanded_and_peak_memory_bytes: Unknown until full ZIP/member census. The entire required compressed derivative is under 0.8 GB; this is not a one-fly convenience subset.
whole_input_inventory.full_paper_extensions: Freely walking silencing cohorts and controls (including empty-Gal4/empty-split), anatomical imaging, and Dryad plume movie 10.5061/dryad.g27mq71 are required to reproduce causal and simulation claims. Their complete input bytes are not yet inventoried; no full-paper replication claimed.

derivation_and_exposure.documented: Motion-corrected dual-channel images; manually selected columns; fluorescence baseline uses lowest 3% over all trials, then synchronized to behavior. Signals include already-derived bump fields, which are not accepted as ground truth without provenance.
derivation_and_exposure.historical_bump: Paper threshold mean+0.5 SD over whole experiment; minimum duration 3 s and gap-merging under 3 s; often conditioned on future bump offset. Those noncausal definitions cannot be used as forecast-time features.
derivation_and_exposure.protected_inputs: All models receive only directly exposed history ending at the offset, with the common clock/availability masks above. Post-offset odor and behavior, future-derived bump presence/duration/offset, straightness, whole-test statistics and figure caches are forbidden. Historical two-sided filters need a separately specified past-only learned comparator before use in prediction.
derivation_and_exposure.offline_derivative_limit: The selected endpoint is explicitly retrospective and conditional on released derivatives. sync2struct estimates fluorescence baselines over all trials; other transforms can use whole-trial/whole-experiment values. Exposed pre-offset dFF can therefore embody later observations. Match derivative provenance across all neural comparators and report normalization sensitivity; masking direct future samples alone cannot certify prospective exposure. A genuinely prospective variant requires sufficient authentic parent inputs and qualified past/calibration-only normalization and registration, a distinct condition within this family.

protected_split.unit: Fly, with every trial/ROI/window from the same fly staying together; preserve overlap between pulse and plume recordings.
protected_split.proposal: Outer leave-one-fly-out within genotype, shared across stimulus conditions, with every trial/ROI/case from one fly kept together and overlapping pulse/plume identities resolved. Select model, regularization and any learned transformations only on remaining flies. Freeze full identity map, prespecified quality exclusions, event/pseudo-event rules and direct-input masks before outcomes.
protected_split.grouping: Never treat 222 bumps, 143 plume bumps or frames as independent animals. Bootstrap/permutation at fly level and show all animal effects. Small genotype cohorts limit inference; no trial-level pseudoreplication.
protected_split.causal_exposure: Odor encounters and wind tuning arise in a closed loop; wind speed was manually optimized per fly. Control elapsed trial time, prior heading/speed, wind speed, odor history, genotype and session. Re-encounter strata are descriptive selection, not randomized treatment effects.

competent_baselines.name: Nuisance dynamics
competent_baselines.definition: Past-window autoregressive ridge and nonlinear boosted-tree/compact temporal predictors from permitted odor, wind and locomotor histories; naive movement persistence as a floor. Training and selection remain within allowed fly groups. Two-sided historical filters are excluded.

competent_baselines.name: Neural increment
competent_baselines.definition: The same model classes and information boundary with permitted synchronized green/red fluorescence histories, using matched released-derivative provenance and normalization controls. Report paired fly-level incremental loss.

competent_baselines.name: Published dynamics versus stabilized comparison
competent_baselines.definition: Literal published equation-7/filter and threshold-persistence analyses are historical diagnostics. A separately labeled stabilized, past-window train-only estimator may be a comparator; never call it literal published reproduction.

competent_baselines.name: Controls
competent_baselines.definition: Red/motion-channel comparator, trial-preserving neural time shift, within-fly mismatched-trial neural pairing, prespecified no-odor/no-wind pseudo-offset diagnostics, genotype-specific effects and descriptive re-encounter strata. All chosen comparisons and animal-level multiplicity handling are frozen before test inspection.

official_code.rights: GPL-3.0 LICENSE verified in pinned complete source tree; all 47 Git blobs downloaded as source only and checked against Git blob SHA-1 and lengths.
specific_gaps: Final paper equation (7) and active source both use inverse singular value plus lambda: 1/Sigma + lambda. They agree. This is not standard ridge/Tikhonov shrinkage and can amplify small singular values; preserve the literal form for replay, with singular/near-singular handling explicitly recorded. Name any stabilization separately.
Historical recipe still requires reconciliation of input normalization versus cross-correlation normalization, filter smoothing/peak thresholds, trial concatenation boundaries and sample selection.

Figure scripts call allflies_filenames_all while data README promises allflies_filenames.m; the required map is absent from the complete Git tree and may be in the data archive. Resolve before execution.

Persistence script successively overwrites fly lists and ends at 12 IDs while the historical pulse description has 14 selected flies; wind-shift plotting contains a selected event-index list. Reconcile these, the six/five filter lists and complete eligible cohorts without assuming integer IDs are unique animals.

Pulse/plume scripts calculate FDR outputs but shade unadjusted h_values; paired-looking comparisons sometimes use ttest2. These are historical recipe/inference gates, not evidence that the paper is false. Protected uncertainty must use paired animal-level losses and prespecified comparisons.
Utility filenames end with copy.m and paths are machine-specific; README acknowledges incomplete raw import dependencies. No executable package success is claimed.

historical_numbers: Paper reports an exponential bump-persistence time constant around 5.59 s and broader odor filters for VT062617. These are published observations, not reproduced results and not compulsory positive outcomes for a scorer.
construction_gates: Census complete 2p/PID archives and all relevant control cohorts; reconcile fly identities and every historical quality/selection list without silently reducing the prospective declared scientific unit.
Qualify reference frames, wrap convention, speed/rotation units, nominal versus hardware time, physical odor delay, circular-goal missingness and shared target/control denominators.

Freeze the retrospective released-derivative interpretation and all direct-input/future-field masks; implement the required normalization sensitivities without calling secondary rescaling a causal repair.
Resolve literal historical equation/filter normalization/smoothing/selection/inference recipes separately from constructing a scientifically sound held-horizon reference.
Later validate grouped past-window nuisance/neural comparators, paired fly-level uncertainty, no-odor diagnostic schedules and leakage challenges.
dedup: No identity match in original200, broader catalogue or expansion V9. Added APCx task concerns odor quantity and source identity; this asks navigation-memory dynamics in identified fan-shaped-body populations. It does not reuse a prior odor task with a new modality or representation.

case_and_coordinate_contract.heading: Use integrated FicTrac yaw in a consistent reference frame, including the wind-shift trials where source code uses calc_heading rather than wind-tube/motor position. Verify radians/degrees, wrapping, zero reference and continuity from the native schema. Motor angle may be a historical ordinary-trial quantity, but is not silently substituted for animal heading during wind rotation.
case_and_coordinate_contract.speed: The target uses the verified mm/s calc_speed quantity. calc_deltapitch is a rotation rate and cannot be substituted without the documented ball-radius/unit conversion; source code contains a 9.52/2 conversion, while the physical ball specification must be reconciled. The chosen scalar speed times heading cosine is named goal-aligned speed until its relation to physical displacement is validated.
case_and_coordinate_contract.time: Reconcile nominal reconstructed dff_ts = sample_index/FrameRate + trigger with actual imaging/behavior clocks, sample count, dropped frames and physical odor delay from PID. No claim that this nominal clock is hardware-exact.
case_and_coordinate_contract.goal_missingness: Require finite heading with at least 95% of expected samples in the one-second goal interval, no gap over two native behavior-frame intervals, and circular resultant length at least 1e-6. Otherwise goal direction is undefined and the case receives an explicit reason code. No outcome-dependent heading repair.
case_and_coordinate_contract.horizon: Require the complete five-second target interval within the same trial, with at least 95% expected finite speed/heading samples and no gap over two behavior-frame intervals. Compute the time-weighted mean over valid samples using the frozen clock convention; never fill from another trial. Common eligibility applies to all models, with per-fly/genotype/condition and missingness denominators.
case_and_coordinate_contract.short_history: The history interval is (offset-10 s,offset], truncated only at the same trial start and accompanied by the same availability mask for all models. Neither features nor goal estimation use directly supplied post-offset data. This direct-input boundary does not undo offline derivative exposure.
case_and_coordinate_contract.no_odor_controls: No-odor/no-wind trials do not have natural odor offsets. Score them as separately labeled diagnostics using the fixed nominal pulse-off time from the authentic acquisition schedule for the same paradigm; define that schedule from metadata before outcome inspection. For a plume control lacking such a schedule, use a fixed-seed offset schedule drawn only from training-fly command times matched on paradigm/duration, never from held behavior/neural outcomes. Keep the full controls and report available/eligible pseudo-offset counts. If an authentic map cannot be established, retain the control gate rather than manufacture event times.
case_and_coordinate_contract.future_reencounters: Never select primary inputs/cases using future re-encounters. Report these afterward as descriptive endogenous-exposure strata, not randomized causal effects.

normalization_sensitivity.required: Compare the released-derivative reference with clearly labeled train/calibration-only secondary centering/scaling of those derivatives, and document dependence on normalization/selection choices. Such postprocessing does not undo the all-trial F0 and is not a causal repair.
normalization_sensitivity.when_parent_inputs_exist: If authentic sufficient fluorescence/calibration parents become available, evaluate a separately qualified past-only normalization variant under the same grouped evaluation. Parent-input availability is not assumed and is not replaced by invented raw arrays.
normalization_sensitivity.interpretation: Report any apparent neural gain as conditional retrospective information; do not interpret it as future-uncontaminated prospective neural predictability without the separate qualification.
